I hold the position: **"Replace tipping with higher fixed wages"**

One reason for this position is that **tipping can create income instability and inequality for service staff**. When tips are unpredictable and variable, service staff may struggle to make a living wage, leading to financial insecurity and stress. By replacing tipping with higher fixed wages, service staff can have a more stable and predictable income, which is essential for their financial well-being and overall quality of life.
